thesis: The page is the field ledger: every section is a ruled entry row carrying a measurement, a status stamp and the next action, and the signature is the steel-blue rule that draws itself across each row as the reading is logged.

signature.name: Ledger Rule + Status Stamp
signature.summary: A horizontal steel-blue rule underlines every section like a line on a graph-paper field book; each entry row carries an entry number in mono, a measurement or reading, a status stamp pill (OK · WATCH · FIX) and the action verb. The rule animates on scroll via --sw-p clip-path wipe.

motion.intro: Three ledger rows type in sequentially on the left (300ms each, stagger 200ms), rule draws under each; right-side camera still slowly pushes forward with foot counter ticking. Skippable; text in DOM before animation.
stories: Ledger rule wipes left-to-right across each section driven by --sw-p
Vertical foot-counter in margin climbs through camera/lateral story, stops at named findings, reverses on scroll-up
motion.hover: Hairline underline grows from left via scaleX(0→1) on links and buttons, 200ms, transform-origin: left, inside @media (hover:hover)
